accounts.name: vesting_vault
docs: (Anchor's token `init` here uses too much memory and crashes the program).

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the PLATFORM admin — checked against PlatformConfig.admin
below. This is the ONLY wallet ever able to call create_pool.
Partner communities never call this themselves, even for their
own pool — pool creation is a manual, relationship-driven action.

accounts.name: main_wtf_pool
docs: deterministic PDA of your main WTF pool BEFORE that pool exists —
it doesn't need to be created yet for this call to succeed.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero.

errors.name: InsufficientStake
errors.msg: Insufficient staked balance for this unstake amount.

errors.name: RewardRateTooHigh
errors.msg: Reward rate exceeds the maximum allowed value.

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Math operation overflowed.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the pool admin can perform this action.

errors.name: AdminRenounced
errors.msg: Admin authority has been renounced; this action is permanently disabled.

errors.name: InsufficientRewardVault
errors.msg: Reward vault does not have enough funds to pay this claim.

errors.name: PoolPaused
errors.msg: Pool is currently paused.

errors.name: InvalidStakeMint
errors.msg: Provided token mint does not match the pool's staking mint.

errors.name: InvalidVaultAccount
errors.msg: Provided vault account does not match the pool's expected vault.

errors.name: NoRewardsAvailable
errors.msg: Nothing to claim right now.

errors.name: DonationTooSmall
errors.msg: Donation amount too small to be worth recording.

errors.name: InvalidLockTier
errors.msg: Invalid lock tier index. Must be between 1 (1 day) and 6 (1 year).

errors.name: LockTierConflict
errors.msg: Cannot select a different lock tier while a stronger lock is still active. Wait for it to expire, or unstake fully first.

errors.name: VestingFullyClaimed
errors.msg: Vesting schedule has already been fully claimed.

errors.name: NothingVestedYet
errors.msg: Nothing is currently claimable — you're still inside the cliff period.

errors.name: NotRevocable
errors.msg: This vesting schedule is not revocable.

errors.name: AlreadyRevoked
errors.msg: This vesting schedule has already been revoked.

errors.name: InvalidVestingSchedule
errors.msg: Vesting end time must be after start time, and cliff must fall within that range.

errors.name: PresaleNotStarted
errors.msg: Presale has not started yet.

errors.name: PresaleEnded
errors.msg: Presale has already ended.

errors.name: PresaleHardCapExceeded
errors.msg: This purchase would exceed the presale hard cap.

errors.name: PresaleAmountTooSmall
errors.msg: SOL amount is too small to purchase any tokens at the current price.

errors.name: BoostAlreadyActivated
errors.msg: Investor boost has already been activated for this stake position.

errors.name: InvestorRecordMismatch
errors.msg: This investor record does not belong to the caller.

errors.name: PlatformFeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Platform fee exceeds the maximum allowed rate.

errors.name: NotMainPoolStake
errors.msg: This UserStake account does not belong to the main WTF pool.

errors.name: PoolCreationNotAuthorized
errors.msg: Only the platform admin can create new staking pools.

errors.name: PositionOccupied
errors.msg: That position slot already holds a stake. Pick an empty slot (0-4).

errors.name: InvalidPositionSlot
errors.msg: Invalid position slot. Must be between 0 and 4.

errors.name: PositionEmpty
errors.msg: This position is empty.

errors.name: PositionMismatch
errors.msg: Position does not belong to this user and pool.

errors.name: LaunchBonusTooHigh
errors.msg: Launch bonus or duration exceeds the allowed maximum.

errors.name: LaunchNotSet
errors.msg: The presale launch time has not been set yet.

errors.name: BoostWindowClosed
errors.msg: The investor boost is not active yet or has already ended.

errors.name: PresaleAdminOnly
errors.msg: Only the presale admin can do this.

fields.name: launch_ts
docs: Unix time the token launched (0 = not set yet). Investor boost runs from here.

types.name: StakePosition
docs: One independent locked deposit. Each user can hold up to MAX_POSITIONS
per pool (slots 0..MAX_POSITIONS-1). A slot is free when amount == 0.

fields.name: weight
docs: amount * (1 + lock bonus) as last computed; included in UserStake.lock_shares.

fields.name: launch_bonus_bps
docs: Launch bonus (bps over 1x) captured when this position was staked.

types.name: UserStake
docs: Per-user, per-pool summary. Holds pending rewards, the investor boost and
the running totals. The individual locked deposits live in `StakePosition`.

fields.name: shares
docs: Total reward shares = lock_shares + investor-boost shares.

fields.name: lock_shares
docs: Sum of every position's lock-weighted amount (see StakePosition.weight).
